envelope.description: Rewire the backend's vibe call sites onto the adapter; delete runVibe/vibeArgs

body.title: Rewire the backend's vibe call sites onto the adapter; delete runVibe/vibeArgs
body.summary: complete() builds a new-session VibeTurnRequest (no selection) and consumes startTurn, returning the final assistant text. completeStructuredVibe() builds a VibeTurnRequest and consumes startTurn, keeping its existing local two-attempt ajv validation loop and the schema note riding the prompt (the tool has no native schema flag). The interactive-tools/auto-approve path maps its auto-approve flag onto the request's approval input. readOnlySessionOnce() builds a mode:'read-only' request whose tool-name set comes from the adapter's sc2 VibeInsrcAnalysisToolId allowlist -- the adapter refuses it before dispatch (the s1 fail-closed state, matching today's READ_ONLY_SESSION_VIBE_TOOL_NAMES behavior one-for-one). runVibe() and vibeArgs() are deleted outright -- the provider stops constructing vibe argv or branching into the app-server transport.
acceptanceChecks: complete() for kind 'vibe' builds exactly one VibeTurnRequest and consumes the adapter -- a grep-level assertion confirms no vibeArgs/runVibe reference remains in cli-provider.ts
completeStructuredVibe keeps the local two-attempt ajv validation loop unchanged: a first invalid answer retries once, a second raises ModelResponseShapeError naming the schema errors
readOnlySessionOnce's request uses the adapter's sc2 allowlist and is refused before any subprocess spawns, with the same ReadOnlyUnavailableError-shaped surfaced reason as today's refusal
the provider's existing withTransientRetry still wraps every vibe path: a transient error text from the seam retries a fresh invocation once, a deterministic failure re-throws on attempt 1
a backend vibe request (complete/completeStructuredVibe/readOnlySessionOnce) spawns exactly one subprocess per turn through the adapter (seam-recorded spawn count)

tests.name: provider.complete for kind 'vibe' builds a single VibeTurnRequest and consumes the adapter — no private argv path remains (grep-level assertion: no vibeArgs/runVibe in cli-provider.ts)

completeStructuredVibe keeps the local two-attempt ajv validation loop — a first invalid answer retries once, a second raises ModelResponseShapeError naming the errors
the schema note rides the prompt — the prompt passed to the spawn seam contains the output contract
